source.text:
Harrowdene Housing Association
Our reference: HX539621

Dear Pamela,

We are writing to let you know that external redecoration and gutter replacement will begin at your building on 22 April 2026. Scaffolding will be erected the week before.

You do not need to do anything for the works to go ahead. Our contractor, O'Sullivan & Sons, will knock before working near your windows.

If you have a medical condition that means noise or dust would affect you, please tell us within 28 days so we can plan around it.

Work is expected to take 7 weeks, weather permitting.

Kind regards,
Steven Harris-Winter
Harrowdene Housing Association

HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

We hold the details on this letter to administer your account and to meet our legal duties. We do not sell personal information. Our full privacy notice sets out what we hold, how long we keep it and who we share it with, and is available on request from the address at the head of this letter.

Where we share information with another organisation it is because the law requires it or because that organisation acts for us under a written agreement. We keep records for as long as the account is open and for six years afterwards.
